text: Here's how to make commentary Shorts people watch to the end.
Most beginners lose viewers in two seconds. Fix it in five steps!
One. Pick a clip that opens with a question.
Two. Say the payoff first, in under eight words.
Three. Cut every pause. No silence longer than a breath.
Four. Don't narrate the clip. React to it every three seconds.
Five. End on a line that loops back to the start.
That's how my channel hit 9.2M views in 28 days.
